title: Score Validator
summary: Given a string array events, initialize score to 0 and counter to 0.
statement: Given a string array events, initialize score to 0 and counter to 0. For each element in events, if it is '0' to '4' or '6', add its value to score. If it is 'W', increment counter. If 'WD' or 'NB', add 1 to score. Stop when all elements are processed or counter reaches 10. Return [score, counter].
constraints: Digit events add their numeric value; WD and NB add one.
W increments the wicket counter but adds no score.
Stop immediately after the tenth W and return [score,wickets].
hints: Classify digits, W, and the two one-point tokens.
Break as soon as the W count reaches ten.
The loop order ensures no event after the stop condition is scored.
editorial: The loop order ensures no event after the stop condition is scored.

tests.explanation: The numeric events add eleven, WD adds one, and one W is recorded.
Processing stops at the tenth W, so the trailing six is ignored.
